page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.48xlarge is a storage-optimized server built on the Nitro hypervisor. It is powered by Intel Xeon 8559C processors utilizing the x86_64 architecture, providing 192 vCPUs across 96 physical cores with a base clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The system is equipped with 1536.0 GB of DDR5 memory running at 6 GHz, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per core. A defining feature of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, offering 120,000 GB of NVMe SSD storage. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate top-tier performance in multi-core processing and memory throughput. The server ranks in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core CPU tests, Passmark CPU scores, and database operations. Memory bandwidth for both small cached blocks and large uncached blocks also falls into the top 10% tier, although the overall Passmark memory score is positioned in the average middle 50%. Single-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng single-core results aligning with the middle 50% average. Redis SET operations demonstrate exceptional throughput, reaching 203.2 million operations per second.

With 120 TB of local NVMe SSD storage and 1.5 TB of DDR5 RAM, this server offers high resource density. It provides qualitative cost efficiency for data-intensive operations by eliminating the latency and cost overhead of external storage attachments. The hardware configuration is optimized for large-scale relational databases, high-throughput NoSQL databases, massive Redis caching layers, and enterprise data warehousing workloads.
